maint.bad_time: Time must be in HH:MM format (e.g. 03:30).
maint.bad_keep: The number of backups to keep must be between 1 and 60.
maint.bad_log_days: Log retention must be at least 7 days (0 = unlimited).
maint.panic: An unexpected error occurred; details are in the server log.

backup.upload_bad_form: Invalid upload: the file and fields must be sent as multipart/form-data.
backup.upload_no_file: The upload contains no backup file.
backup.upload_duplicate_field: The {name} field appears more than once in the upload.
backup.owner_code_required: Two-step verification is on: a verification code is required.
backup.entry_too_large: {name} in the backup is too large (max {mb} MB)
backup.missing_file: The backup has no {name}; this is not a valid Kut backup
backup.newer_version: The backup is from a newer Kut version; update Kut first
backup.pre_backup_failed: Could not take the pre-restore backup: {msg}

notify.bad_token: Bot token format is wrong (example: 123456789:AAH…). Paste it exactly as you got it from @BotFather.
notify.bad_chat_id: A chat ID consists of digits only. Use the "Find chat" button.
notify.telegram_incomplete: Turning on Telegram requires a bot token and a chat ID.
notify.bad_webhook_url: Webhook URL must start with http:// or https://.
notify.webhook_no_url: Turning on the webhook requires a URL.
notify.bad_quiet_time: Quiet hours must be in HH:MM format (e.g. 23:00).
notify.quiet_incomplete: Quiet hours need both a start and an end.
notify.no_channel: Turn on a channel and save first.
notify.no_chat_yet: No messages yet. Open @{bot} in Telegram, send /start, then try again.
notify.webhook_unreachable: Could not reach the webhook target
notify.webhook_rejected: The webhook target did not accept the request

update.no_release: No release has been published yet
